notes.title: Update April 18th
notes.content: -Finally fixed the minimap. Now works much better than before.

notes.title: Reversion to prior patch
notes.content:
Had to revert to a prior patch for now, as something broke the new minimap plugin. While I figure out
what it is I'm reverting to the prior version. Hopefully this won't take long!

- Adjusted maximum level to 99. However higher levels need more exp to reach than before.
- More random events
- Minor Bugfixes
